data.question: How does the Palantir founder network connect recursively to JD Vance, Donald Trump, related organizations and the current executive branch?
data.method: Recursive graph expansion from Palantir to founder, venture, campaign-finance, personnel, policy and procurement nodes; official records prioritized and media used for employment or project facts not available in official biographies.
data.framework: capital -> mentorship/employment -> electoral support -> appointment -> policy authority -> procurement/data-system opportunity
data.scope: Depth 0 Palantir; depth 1 Peter Thiel; depth 2 JD Vance and political-capital organizations; depth 3 executive personnel, policy and reported federal data projects.
findings: Thiel-to-Vance is a sequence rather than a single association:mentorship, Mithril employment, Narya backing, large super-PAC support and eventual vice-presidential elevation.
Former Palantir personnel hold unusually relevant technology and data roles at HHS and OMB/GSA; Helberg connects Palantir's executive advisory network to the State Department.
Former Thiel Capital principal Michael Kratsios directs White House science and technology policy.
EO 14243 orders broad interagency data access and consolidation, creating a policy environment aligned with Palantir's integration products.
Palantir was separately reported participating with DOGE and IRS engineers in a unified IRS API effort.
The evidence supports a distributed influence architecture combining capital, personnel, policy and procurement opportunity.
conclusions: The strongest evidence concerns network pathways and capability-policy alignment.
No reviewed source proves a coordinated conspiracy, unlawful procurement, or command by Vance or Thiel over individual Palantir awards.
counterarguments: Officials may be selected for technical competence independent of prior affiliations.
EO 14243 applies government-wide and does not name Palantir.
FEC MUR 8009 did not establish an unlawful coordination violation.
limitations: OGE ethics agreements, recusals and communications were not fully retrieved.
IRS award modifications and technical architecture were not resolved.
Some employment histories rely on high-quality media or self-published biographies rather than government biographies.
unresolved: Palantir-linked officials' OGE disclosures and recusals
Meeting and communications chronology linking policy, appointments and awards

inferences: The network is best modeled as distributed influence architecture rather than one chain of command.
counterevidence: EO 14243 is vendor-neutral on its face.
MUR 8009 did not establish a violation.
